name: qualified-generation-audit
cmd: bun -e 'import{readFileSync,readdirSync}from"node:fs";import{strict as assert}from"node:assert";const floorText=readFileSync("quiet-calibration/quiet-floor-extension.log","utf8"),floors=JSON.parse(floorText.slice(floorText.indexOf("QUIET_FLOORS ")+13)),placement=JSON.parse(readFileSync("generation-data/placement.json","utf8"));let complete=0,total=0;for(const file of readdirSync("generation-data").filter(f=>f.endsWith(".log"))){const text=readFileSync("generation-data/"+file,"utf8"),lines=text.split("\n"),runs=lines.filter(l=>l.startsWith("GENERATOR_QUIET_RUN ")).map(l=>JSON.parse(l.slice(20))),summary=lines.filter(l=>l.startsWith("GENERATOR_PREFLIGHT ")).map(l=>JSON.parse(l.slice(20)));if(!summary.length)continue;assert.equal(summary.length,1);const p=placement[file.slice(0,-4)];assert(p?.exclusive&&p.co_tenants===0);const rows=runs.map(r=>{const f=floors.floors[r.model],probe=q=>!!(q?.ok&&q.ticks>0&&q.stealRatio<=0.001&&q.cpuMs<=Math.min(165,1.1*f.cpuMs)&&q.memoryMs<=Math.min(650,1.1*f.memoryMs)),ok=!!(f&&r.microSha256===floors.microSha256&&r.model===p.cpu&&probe(r.pre)&&probe(r.post)&&r.across?.ticks>0&&r.across.stealRatio<=0.001&&!r.error&&r.result);assert.equal(r.accepted,ok);return{repeat:r.repeat,accepted:ok,reason:r.reason,error:r.error,pre:r.pre,post:r.post,across:r.across,structural:r.result?.structural}});total+=rows.length;assert.equal(summary[0].complete,rows.length===3&&rows.every(r=>r.accepted));if(summary[0].complete)complete++;console.log("GENERATOR_QUALIFICATION_AUDIT "+JSON.stringify({file,vm:p.vm,cpu:p.cpu,summary:summary[0],rows}))}console.log("GENERATOR_QUALIFICATION_TOTAL "+JSON.stringify({completeCohorts:complete,attempts:total,scope:"independent hardware-admission audit; not a proof gate"}))'
